notes: Extended 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB491): GR14's 'es' entry now has a site of its own, EditingPositions, beside the 'cs' entry's currencyExtra. Both are the SAME remainder over CharacterPositions' one-per-symbol count, so the two variable-width symbols are sized by one shape: 'es' counts literal-1's size at EVERY occurrence of a simple- or fixed-insertion character-1 and, for floating insertion, 'one occurrence of literal-2 or literal-3 ... plus one character for each repetition of character-1'. MEASURED against Annex D.24's stated arithmetic (PIC LLLL9,88 with "DEBIT " = 13 characters: 6 for the first L, 3 for the next three, 4 for the numbers) and against the alphanumeric-edited IS form (PIC XXTXX EDITING T IS "::" = 6). The ExpandCurrency code-location this row carried is gone; the currency half of the same rule is now Materialize. EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10: in force at 85, in part, §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR8 'The functions of the symbols used to describe an elementary item are explained as follows', which states the function and size count of B, P, S, V, X, Z, 9, 0, /, the comma, the period, + - CR DB, * and the currency symbol (for example 'Each 'X' in the character-string is used to represent a character position which contains any allowable character from the computer's character set and is counted in the size of the item'); the symbols N, 1, E and the locale editing symbols are not 1985 symbols, and 1985's 'A' 'can contain only an alphabetic character'.
